text:
Ben (Events): Quick preflight — we're running the Geo Bridges microsessions next Wed. Need check on greenroom routing, per-region clip split, RTMP fallback, and lead tagging. Who's owning?
Carmen (Growth): I can own lead tagging + CRM routing. Need the final HubSpot stage list tho.
Alice (Demand Gen): tagging: webinar_attended, clip_viewed, followup_requested. We should also add campaign=geo-bridges and region tag.
Diego (Ops): RTMP fallback config is ready, but need the ingest endpoints for each region. Evan / Fiona, can you confirm greenroom streams?
Evan (Design): Greenrooms set for NA/EU/APAC. NA greenroom has live captions ON, EU/APAC need SRT bursts.
Fiona (Intl): I'll localize the registration page copy and set timezones. Reminder: APAC presenters prefer 09:30 JST start.
Ben (Events): Good. Diego — paste the RTMP fallback snip here so Carmen can wire Zap routing with region param.
Diego (Ops): Sure — snippet below for the encoder fallback priority:
```
rtmp://primary.use-west-1.redwood.example/live/geo-bridges
rtmp://fallback-eu.redwood.example/live/geo-bridges
rtmp://fallback-apac.redwood.example/live/geo-bridges
priority: primary, eu, apac
```
Carmen (Growth): Perfect. For Zapier -> HubSpot mapping I'm using this:
```
trigger: zoom.recording.completed
fields:
  region: region_code
  email: participant_email
  campaign: geo-bridges
  asset_tag: clip_${region}_${timestamp}
  hs_lifecycle_stage: webinar_attended
```
Alice (Demand Gen): For clip ownership: we want 3x clips per session (highlights, full session, teasers). Diego can you add marker metadata so clips auto-split?
Diego (Ops): Yep — we'll emit markers at 00:00, 00:45:00, 01:30:00 depending on session length. Also adding per-region metadata header: `X-Region: #{region}`.
ZoomBot: Recording started (session: Geo Bridges - APAC).
Fiona (Intl): Small ask — captions: are we using auto-SRT or vendor? Auto-SRT OK for EN, vendor for JP/CN. Budget confirmed.
Evan (Design): Layout note: add subtle region watermark in lower-left for analytics — helps clip attribution.
Carmen (Growth): CRM routing logic: if region=APAC -> HubSpot account: HS-APAC, EU -> HS-EU, else HS-NA. Also tag owner: `owner: ${region}_demand`.
Ben (Events): Who's doing post-event nurture emails? Alice? Need cadence and clip attachments.
Alice (Demand Gen): Yep. Cadence: 1) thank you + full recording (24h), 2) highlights + CTA (3 days), 3) teaser + demo invite (10 days). Will rely on clip assets from Diego.
Diego (Ops): Note on recording splits: we'll split on markers and produce filenames like `geo-bridges_{region}_{type}_{ts}.mp4`. Pushing to S3 under `events/geo-bridges/{region}/`.
Carmen (Growth): HubSpot workflow sample rule: `IF property campaign = geo-bridges AND hs_lifecycle_stage = webinar_attended THEN add to list: geo-bridges-attendees AND enqueue nurture`.
Ben (Events): We also need a fallback plan if RTMP fails mid-session — auto-switch to native Zoom stream and mark asset as `fallback_zoom`. Diego add a boolean in metadata.
Diego (Ops): Added: `fallback_used: true|false` in recording manifest. Also pushing a simple health check every 60s to the ops channel.
Evan (Design): Quick accessibility check: ensure transcripts are available within 24h and thumbnails have alt text.
Fiona (Intl): Registrants for JP/CN: require localized confirmation email and opt-in link for clip reuse. I'll prep copy.
Ben (Events): Preflight checklist for tomorrow:
- Diego: RTMP endpoints + marker emission ✅
- Carmen: Zap -> HS mapping + workflows ✅
- Alice: nurture cadence + templates (draft) ✅
- Evan: watermark + thumbnail specs ✅
- Fiona: localized reg copy + opt-in ✅
- Ben: run greenroom schedule + presenter invites (in progress)
Carmen (Growth): One last ask — can we append `orig_timezone` to payload so nurture emails show local times?
Diego (Ops): Added field `orig_timezone` to participant metadata.
Ben (Events): Awesome. Final: drop link to the playbook here when updated. Everyone pls react with :thumbsup: when done.
Alice (Demand Gen): will update templates today. :thumbsup:
Fiona (Intl): copy done, pinging presenters. :thumbsup:
Evan (Design): assets uploaded to Figma and s3. :thumbsup:
Diego (Ops): RTMP + manifest tests passing in staging. :thumbsup:
Carmen (Growth): HubSpot workflows queued. :thumbsup:
ZoomBot: Recording stopped (session: Geo Bridges - APAC) duration 00:58:12. Manifest available: s3://events/geo-bridges/APAC/manifest.json
Ben (Events): Closing thread — thanks everyone. We'll smoke-test the entire flow 10:00 PST tomorrow.
